Two exported functions retain the caller-owned map and project content-free summary data. The original private DIFF_TIMEOUT_MS name is restored for the existing 5000 ms timeout budget.
chosenStructure.newState: No new mutable state; the required immutable timeout constant name is restored. Per-call counters, patch reference, fallback/stat objects and summary arrays retain V1 behavior.
chosenStructure.ownership: Caller owns supplied RuntimeTurnFileChangeMap and contents; existing map, entries and Sets retain their identities.

manualContractReview.method: Manual comparison of authorized seven inputs and own frozen V1, followed by manual review of the complete V2 source. Only scoped text replacement and file accounting; no runtime execution, compiler, tests, lint, mocks or build.

checks: Only the supplied runtime/type imports and exactly two exports appear.
Counter starts fresh additions/deletions at zero; nested for-of visits each hunk and line; independent plus and minus startsWith checks each increment by one.
No counter header filtering, skipping, trimming, normalization, validation or catch changes native failure behavior.
recordTurnFileChange fully computes fallback before any changes.get or input.path access, even for an existing record.
changes.get retains its receiver; falsey existing branch uses changes.set with repeated live path reads.
New record own fields follow afterContent, beforeContent, fallbackAdditions, fallbackDeletions, path, toolNames, writeCount order; undefined afterContent and null beforeContent remain stored.
New record has new Set([input.toolName]), writeCount one and no retained patch array.
Existing record performs afterContent nullish update, fallback additions, fallback deletions, Set.add, writeCount increment in the required order.
Existing entry/Set identities, original beforeContent/path and existing map are preserved; no replacement or duplicate collection.
Empty string remains meaningful; runtime null or undefined afterContent preserves existing via nullish behavior.
Native getter, iterator, mutation and port errors propagate with possible partial changes; no catch or rollback.
Empty map size strictly equal to zero returns undefined before values iteration.
Array.from(changes.values()).map evaluates records in map iteration order.
afterContent undefined selects fresh fallback stat object; otherwise live beforeContent nullish empty, afterContent and path are evaluated in that order.
structuredPatch receives filePath twice, beforeContent, afterContent, undefined twice and timeout 5000.
patch optional hunks nullish empty array leads to zero counts for undefined timed-out patch, without fallback substitution.
Mapped items have additions, deletions, path, Array.from(toolNames).sort() and writeCount in order.
Items use native sort with left.path.localeCompare(right.path); default tool name sort and native stable item sort are preserved.
Summary owns additions and deletions computed by separate zero-based reductions, files from items.length and the same produced items array.
Summary contains no content or patch bodies and does not mutate caller-owned maps, records or Sets.
Source is a single 92-line file, below the 400-line limit, with no added features, persistence, I/O, logs, grants or transactions.
Private DIFF_TIMEOUT_MS equals 5000 and is referenced in the existing structuredPatch timeout option.
Only the two authorized source text edits are present; naming restoration does not expand behavior, APIs, imports, state, data or ports.
Own frozen V1 source and receipt retain their observed bytes, hashes and modes; V1 output directory mode remains 0555.
